title: Video Calling Family Abroad
paragraphs: Since moving abroad for work two years ago, Dewi calls her parents every Sunday evening using a video app, something that was much harder and more expensive to do regularly in the past.
During one call, her mother struggles to hold the phone steady, so Dewi patiently explains, step by step, how to prop it against a cup on the table instead of holding it the whole time.

The following Sunday, her mother proudly shows off the new setup before Dewi even asks, clearly having practiced it during the week with her father's help, which makes Dewi smile at how quickly she adapted.

Dewi feels grateful that simple technology, once learned patiently, lets her stay closely connected to family despite the physical distance between them, week after week, no matter how busy either side gets.
